about: Recheck of the revised rule-sheet.md (391 lines) against findings F1-F26 of the first check, plus problems the revision made. Line numbers are lines of the revised sheet. Scripts: check/scripts/ unless marked 'sheet:'. Data commit a592331, repository untouched.

findings.note: Same-ability pairing and the escape check moved to a separate checker for rolled cards (P3); HC4 no longer word for word; M1 and M3 say hand-made cards such as the example stay valid; the example card stays unchanged unless K2 is answered A.

The three abilities are listed (sheet: hard-control.mjs re-run: 58 = 47 stun + 11 latch). The weapons paragraph's facts hold (weapon-families texts, no min_tier, cryo allied-favoured, emp empire-favoured, example card's cryo at T1). But question HC does not say that option A departs from decision 5B's words for freezes (decision 5 is about 'stuns and freezes'; 5B: T2 and a medium or longer cooldown), and option C ('rolled only from T2') leaves out the cooldown half of 5B, which HC1 says a weapon cannot meet.
Rolled parts never go above the gate; rolled roles only if holdable at the card's spice. The new sentence in G14 about which roles that affects is wrong: new problem N1.
T-b keeps lines that name real games off cards, but the check it describes lets 21 of its own 106 lines through: new problem N2.

P2 wording 'A key-bound mobility trait and the ability that implies it are one button and count as one key' covers the four deploy-anchor variants of other patterns; K-d widened; K-e matches keys.mjs (1 variant at 2 keys).
Raised as question K2 with correct facts (1B, tiers.json sentence, example card 2 keys). Option A cannot be checked from a card as the schema stands: new problem N3.
A9 now says the card schema and field rules allow deploy forms; question MD states the facts (a mode needs a mobility with a speed; no 'does not move' term exists); P3 checks second forms.
P3 names every item of F8. One wording gap: for death outcomes P3 names only C3, while the drone/crewed-machine limit is in the section 7 row (new problem N7).
A hard-control ability takes medium or long whatever its kind, so burrow/erupt can be offered from T2.
M2 cites 21 per-variant links and heal-aura. Its new label for the 258/70/9/5 counts is wrong: new problem N4.
T6 works out forced parts from the card's recorded inputs and locks; no new field needed; the min_spice check sits in P3's spice-gate check.
TL;DR and section 13 say why no word-list change is needed and that moving numbers into the reserved fields comes later; MU and PT offer that route. Small wording error: new problem N10.
One stream per field; G7 says a lock can change which attempt passes.
Spice 3 opens 130 more variants (142/188/130/35/6 hold).
Bail-out and pilot-eject only for a crewed machine; no wreck with respawn.
Passengers from any pattern or variant that implies or requires them; caps tiny 0, small 1, medium 4, large 6, huge 8; kinds stated. Small source gap: new problem N12.
Seat-swap and needs-crew handled (both rare, as 2A allows).

All seven gaps handled: example unchanged (or changed only under K2 A, stated in P2), modes unchanged with question MD, no new field needed for T6, P3 checker, wider P2 and K-d, K2, word-list prose no longer contradicted. New gap from K2 itself: N3.
Fixed weights open 10, limited 2, unique 1 (77%, 15%, 8% check out: 10/13, 2/13, 1/13); the 31% at spice 5 under rarity odds is right (5/16); options fair.

Now questions or visible: MD, HC (weapons, latches at T1), RF (assault and raider conditions), unarmed role condition marked NEW, dice fixed, term-data routing explained. Passenger caps and death-outcome groups are marked NEW but not asked; acceptable.
G16 (counts above what fits), role fit via the signature or an extra, seats given at step 12, secondary weapon takes its key first. The step table still lists the seat at step 4: new problem N9.
All 15 words dropped. sheet: names.mjs re-run: 110 bank words, 849 working names (17+17x6 + 16x4x9 + 14x11), 3,016 signature names (58x52), 0 collisions.
New rows added and marked. Row wording issues: new problem N8.
Approval items renamed P1-P4; T7 cites P1. Stale 'V (proposed)' remains in three rules: new problem N6.
Shift now cited from CS; the points spread and cost-warning note added. G15 still omits 'themes' and 'label' (trivial).
G11: an implied or required range replaces the default (only infest-vehicle implies a range, melee with attach; range-links.mjs); G12: aim-model rarity applies to mounts.

new_problems.sheet: Today the tools of engineer, logistics and infiltrator are all uncommon or rare, so those roles are rolled only from spice 2.
new_problems.found: True only by base rarity. With flavour leans (S5, recommended answer FL A) some tools count as common: capture-structure leans allied, gather-resources and generate-income lean soviet, infest-vehicle soviet, cloak allied, disguise allied and empire. So at spice 1 engineer can be rolled in 3 of the 54 class/tier/flavour cells, logistics in 12, infiltrator in 27. The sentence also leaves out support and buffer, which cannot be rolled at spice 1 in 18 cells each.
new_problems.evidence: sheet: node scripts/feasibility.mjs, spice-1 list of 156 = engineer 51, logistics 42, infiltrator 27, support 18, buffer 18 (check/rerun/feasibility-recheck.txt); check/scripts/rf-rarity.mjs for the leans.

new_problems.sheet: Such a line never goes onto a card: the generator takes the next line of the same field that passes the name check.
new_problems.found: The name check T-b relies on (T-a's set: unit, faction and registry game names, example unit and ability names, plus game titles from pattern text) catches 85 of the 106 lines. The other 21 name a game by a short form or cite a wiki: 'Generals', 'Red Alert', 'Dawn of War', 'Dota', 'the ... wiki' (e.g. band-together counterplay/0 and /1, become-invulnerable area-curtain counter reasons, earn-veterancy feedback/0, fire-power-shot marked-lock summary). The 106 count came from a scan that also used those short forms; the check needs them too.
new_problems.evidence: check/scripts/tb-method.mjs: 'lines my scan flags: 106 | caught by the T-a name set (plus example game titles): 85 | let through: 21'.

new_problems.sheet: A signature that is the card's primary weapon and is fired with primary fire is not a key.
new_problems.found: Nothing on a card shows that the signature is its primary weapon: an ability part holds pattern, variant, kind, seat and cooldown; a weapon part holds no pattern; controls are free text. So the validator cannot apply the sentence, and the sheet gives the generator no rule for when a signature is the primary weapon. Under K2 A a card-schema field (or a stated rule) is needed, and P1-P4 do not have it.
new_problems.evidence: schemas/concept-card.schema.json $defs/abilityPart and $defs/weaponPart; text.how_it_plays.controls items (seat, input, action).

new_problems.sheet: In the base blocks 258 are the pattern itself, 70 are implied, 9 are required and 5 are not guaranteed (sw-links.mjs).
new_problems.found: The base blocks hold 138 links: 100 self, 30 implied, 5 required, 3 not guaranteed. The 342 (258/70/9/5) are base blocks plus the links written in variant overrides (204). '21 (the checker's count)' comes from no script beside the sheet, though the header says every count does.

new_problems.sheet: at spice 1, from 8 (Soviet aircraft T1) to 31
new_problems.found: That is the first draft's count: signature-counts.mjs still lets implied and required parts skip the spice gate. Under the revised G5 it is 8 to 28 (the figure feasibility.mjs itself prints). The revised G5 also removes repair-allies at spice 1 in 36 of 54 cells (its implied repair tool is uncommon), deploy-siege-mode in 15 and reinforce-squad in 6; the sheet does not mention this.
P3 says the validator's rules stay as they are; these checks now sit in the rolled-card checker. 'V (proposed)' points to a validator change the sheet no longer proposes.

new_problems.sheet: the on-death rules (C3) ... It checks every rule of this sheet that the validator does not.
new_problems.found: The crewed-machine limit (no bail-out for drones) is in the section 7 row (170), not in C3 (180). 'Every rule' is not met by the list: A2 (no null variant on a rolled card), G10-G12 (handling, range, damage, delivery, mount from defaults; targets), M4, N4, B1-B3, the nature row and the availability gates are not named.

new_problems.sheet: + strength or weakness that a variant keeps but no longer guarantees | 21 links; hard control at T1 (borderline) | 3
new_problems.found: Of the 21, only heal-aura's 2 links lost their guarantee in the variant; the other 19 are the 5-link row's base links (line 337) inherited by variants, so the rows overlap. The T1 row changed from the file's 2 to 3 but is not marked +.
new_problems.evidence: check/scripts/my-sw.mjs list; data-problems.json kind hard-control-at-t1 has 2 entries.

new_problems.sheet: step 4: signature: pattern, variant, kind, seat, cooldown
new_problems.found: A5 (line 101) now gives seats out at step 12.

new_problems.sheet: the word lists and the patterns already have empty points and brings fields
new_problems.found: Patterns have no brings field (only word-list terms do), and 4 patterns already store points.
new_problems.evidence: schemas/vocabulary.schema.json $defs/term brings; pattern.schema generator.points; sheet: counts.mjs 'points: 4'.

new_problems.sheet: A4: medium or long (per-life for an ultimate); HC3: medium, long or per-life. Committed-takedown escape /1. TL;DR: the tiers word list says a signature fired with primary fire is not a key.
new_problems.found: A4 and HC3 disagree on per-life for a non-ultimate (harmless, A4 is narrower). execute-target as_target[1] is a line about avoiding the lunge, but is not marked '(avoid)'. The TL;DR drops the word list's condition 'only when it is the unit's primary weapon' (K-a and K2 state it).

FR Paired entries ties passenger seats to carry-passengers or passenger-sets-weapon; the row now lets other patterns add seats without either, which is a new card rule, not FR. G13 has no tool entry for the transport role, though passengers now come only from patterns, so a transport card gets no x3 weight for carry-passengers and no 'holds a pattern that serves it' rule.
new_problems.evidence: docs/fields.md Paired entries; roles.json transport requires passengers:>=2.

held_on_recheck: Section 6 result line (58, 47 stun, 11 latch, 8 break a rule, 2 never offered, 3 without escape, 3 tier only in text, 3 borderline at T1, 4 kept off) matches sheet: hard-control.mjs. Escape indexes of the three new entries exist and no escape line names a real game (hc-escapes.mjs). T-a counts match names.mjs. P2 wording covers F5. SP's 156 is the spice-1 count with every part at the gate (sheet: feasibility.mjs uses spice-1 parts there). AV, MD and section 16 facts hold. The weapons paragraph's facts hold.
